name: Not Enough Mana

categories.label: Last wizard standing
categories.labelVi: Pháp sư cuối cùng còn sống
categories.hint: Others are eliminated at 0 health or by Too Much Mana (K.O.) when unable to continue.

categories.label: Health points remaining at end
categories.labelVi: Máu còn lại khi kết thúc

winCondition: Eliminate all other wizards by reducing their health to 0 or by K.O. (Too Much Mana). The last wizard remaining wins.

endCondition.description: Battle ends when one wizard remains; each wizard starts with 10 health

notes: family: elimination-last-standing. A wizard is eliminated at 0 health or when having Too Much Mana and unable to continue. Team variant (4 or 6 wizards, last team standing wins) and astral-conjunction variant exist; not modelled separately.

sources.title: Not Enough Mana manual (official)
sources.section: Goal; Setup (10 health); Game flow step 3-4; Variants
